new_result.statement: There is a fixed simple-spectrum target matrix A with eigenvalues 1,2,-3,1/2 and independent cap-one product inputs indexed by M for which E ||rho_{123|Q'}||_infinity^(2/3) >= (M/2)^(2/3), while the actual output density remains bounded uniformly in M by a finite constant depending only on A.
new_result.mechanism: Fragment one physical marginal into M far-separated intervals of total measure one. The one-dimensional spectral remainder becomes M disjoint scalar packets. Orthogonal indicator geometry gives ||rho_{123|Y4=s}||_infinity=1/p4(s), so the conditional 2/3 moment equals int p4^(1/3), which grows like M^(2/3).
